title: Verknode Workflow Editor
description: Behaviour of the verknode workflow editor (also editable in the editor: ≡ Settings).

theme.title: Canvas theme
theme.description: Colours of the workflow canvas and nodes. verkaround: nodes coloured by what they do (input emerald/cyan, transform indigo/cobalt, chemistry/statistics violet, ML amber/rose, output teal) in light tints on a light slate canvas. knife: the colours of a popular workflow engine, by node type, on the JupyterLab background. butter: those colours a little muted (between knife and haze), on a warm cream canvas. haze: those colours muted, on a soft off-white canvas. knightmare: those colours on a dark canvas. pipeline-cowboy: the look of a classic workflow engine (readers green, writers red, manipulators blue, filters gold, viewers purple; heavy pipes on light grey).

statusLight.title: Node status lights
statusLight.description: led: three slanted bars - the middle one red (not configured), the outer two yellow (configured), all three green (executed). led-orange: as led, with reddish orange instead of red. traffic: a traffic light with one red, yellow or green dot.

dragBehavior.title: Left-drag on empty canvas
dragBehavior.description: pan: dragging moves the view and Shift+drag draws a selection rectangle. select: dragging draws a selection rectangle and Ctrl+drag (or middle-drag) moves the view.

wheelBehavior.title: Mouse wheel
wheelBehavior.description: zoom: the wheel zooms (pan with Ctrl+drag or middle-drag). pan: the wheel scrolls the canvas and Ctrl+wheel zooms.

arrowNavigation.title: Arrow key navigation
arrowNavigation.description: Arrow keys select the nearest node in that direction. Holding Alt (or after a double tap on Alt, until Alt is tapped again or nothing is selected) they follow the connections: left/right upstream/downstream, up/down a sibling. approximate: among several candidates take the closest by position (siblings above/below). strict: follow port order (first parent, first child, sibling order of the first parent). Shift extends the selection.

viewTarget.title: Open port and node views in
viewTarget.description: window: a separate browser window, tab: a browser tab, dialog: a dialog inside the editor, jupyter: a JupyterLab tab next to the editor (dockable). Holding Ctrl (Cmd) switches window <-> tab (jupyter: browser window). Views stay open when the node is reset and update when it runs again.

showFlowVariablePorts.title: Always show flow variable ports
showFlowVariablePorts.description: Show the implicit flow variable ports of all nodes (otherwise only on hover, selection or when connected).

showScopeBlocks.title: Highlight loops and other blocks
showScopeBlocks.description: Draw faint bubbles around loops, try/catch, IF/CASE switches and other scopes (dashed while not closed).

showPythonCommands.title: Show Python commands in the console
showPythonCommands.description: Print the equivalent verknode command for every edit.

sketcher.title: Molecule Sketcher editor
sketcher.description: Structure editor opened by the Molecule Sketcher: ketcher (EPAM Ketcher) or builtin (hover hotkeys, fixed bond length and 120° geometry). The dialog can switch between them; the last one used is remembered.
